# Contract: Patient Timeline and LGPD Data Requests

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- the application runs as a production build reachable at `http://localhost:3101`, as the E2E configuration of `playwright.config.ts` starts it
- the worker process runs against the same database and delivers outbox messages and scheduled jobs (as `tests/e2e/global-setup.ts` starts it)
- PostgreSQL from `docker-compose.yml` is running with the `gcli_e2e` database migrated to the current schema, including the F14 migration
- the S3-compatible storage from `docker-compose.yml` is running and holds the stored files named below
- a Chromium browser is available for UI and E2E items
- for the integration suites, Docker is available so Testcontainers can start PostgreSQL, Mailpit and SeaweedFS (`tests/integration/global-setup.ts`)

- `request-correction` — an LGPD request of `patient-rich`, type correction, status Pendente, created on the run day. Used by: UI-REQUESTS-05.

  - one finalized note by `pro-helena` with one stored clinical attachment;
  - one stored clinical upload, one stored non-clinical upload and one stored generated document;

- `patient-export-500` — an active patient of `clinic-f14` with 500 stored files across documents, clinical attachments and consents (2 MB on average), plus 500 appointments; with `request-export-500`, an access request in status Pendente. Used by: WRK-EXPORT-02.
- `patient-export-broken` — an active patient of `clinic-f14` with one non-clinical document whose stored file does not exist in storage; with `request-export-broken`, an access request in status Pendente. Used by: UI-EXPORT-02, WRK-EXPORT-03.
- `export-expired` — a ready export of the access request `request-export-expired` (status Concluída), whose file exists in storage and whose availability ended 1 day before the run day. Used by: UI-EXPORT-03, WRK-EXPORT-04.
- `export-fresh` — a ready export of the same request, made 1 day before the run day, whose file exists in storage. Used by: WRK-EXPORT-04.

  - a stored non-clinical upload "RG digitalizado", a generated document, and one consent;
  - no clinical note, clinical document or clinical alert, no future appointment, and no open charge.

  It comes with `request-anon-ok`, an anonymization request in status Pendente. Used by: UI-ANON-01, E2E-ANON-01, E2E-ANON-02, E2E-ANON-03.
- `patient-anon-name` — the active patient "Helena Duarte Ramos" of `clinic-f14`, eligible for anonymization in the same way as `patient-anon-ok`; with `request-anon-name`, an anonymization request in status Pendente. Used by: UI-ANON-02, E2E-ANON-05.
- `patient-anon-clinical` — an active patient of `clinic-f14` with one finalized clinical note and nothing else blocking; with `request-anon-clinical`, an anonymization request in status Pendente. Used by: UI-ANON-03, E2E-ANON-04.
- `patient-anon-clinicaldoc` — an active patient of `clinic-f14` with one clinical document, no clinical note and nothing else blocking; with `request-anon-clinicaldoc`, an anonymization request in status Pendente. Used by: UI-ANON-04.
- `patient-anon-future` — an active patient of `clinic-f14` with no clinical record and one appointment in status Agendado 3 days after the run day; with `request-anon-future`, an anonymization request in status Pendente. Used by: UI-ANON-05, E2E-ANON-05.
- `patient-anon-open` — an active patient of `clinic-f14` with no clinical record, no future appointment and one charge in status Em aberto; with `request-anon-open`, an anonymization request in status Pendente. Used by: UI-ANON-06, E2E-ANON-05.

**Configuration:**
- the E2E environment of `tests/e2e/env.ts` (production mode, `DATABASE_URL` pointing at `gcli_e2e`, `APP_URL=http://localhost:3101`)
- the browser runs with locale `pt-BR` and time zone `America/Sao_Paulo`; every user above uses the pt-BR interface
- the timeline page size is 50 events (`TIMELINE_PAGE_SIZE`), and its latency target is 2,000 ms at p95 (`TIMELINE_P95_MS`)
- a request is overdue when open for more than 15 calendar days (`LGPD_OVERDUE_DAYS`)
- an export stays available for 7 days (`EXPORT_AVAILABILITY_DAYS`), and its generation budget is 5 minutes (`EXPORT_TIME_BUDGET_MS`)
- the export cleanup job (`privacy-exports-cleanup`) can be triggered on demand through the worker's queue, besides its daily schedule
- for the integration suites, the container endpoints are injected by `tests/integration/setup-env.ts`

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready.

- **Lint** — `npm run lint` — ESLint reports no error, including the module boundary rules and the rule against literal text in JSX
- **Typecheck** — `npm run typecheck` — route types are generated and `tsc --noEmit` reports no error
- **Format** — `npm run format:check` — every file matches Prettier
- **Unit tests** — `npm test` — every Vitest unit test passes, including the catalog parity test for the three languages
- **Integration tests** — `npm run test:integration` — every Testcontainers integration test passes
- **Schema drift** — `npx prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code` — the migrated database matches the Prisma schema
- **E2E tests** — `npm run test:e2e` — every Playwright journey passes against the production build
- **Docker image** — `docker build .` — the application image builds

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| Timeline lists all event types in chronological order with 50 events per page, loading in ≤ 2 seconds (p95). | UI-TIMELINE-01, UI-TIMELINE-02, UI-TIMELINE-03, UI-TIMELINE-04, E2E-TIMELINE-01 |
| Front Desk does not see clinical events; Professionals do not see financial events. | UI-VISIBILITY-01, UI-VISIBILITY-02, E2E-VISIBILITY-01, E2E-VISIBILITY-02 |
| Expanding a clinical note in the timeline creates an audit read event. | UI-NOTE-01, E2E-NOTE-READ-01, E2E-NOTE-READ-02 |
| LGPD export produces a ZIP with JSON, PDF summary, and all files within 5 minutes for up to 500 files, available for 7 days. | UI-EXPORT-01, WRK-EXPORT-01, WRK-EXPORT-02, WRK-EXPORT-04, UI-EXPORT-03, E2E-EXPORT-01 |
| Anonymization replaces all personal identifiers irreversibly and keeps appointment and financial records under the anonymized identity. | UI-ANON-01, E2E-ANON-01, E2E-ANON-02, E2E-ANON-03 |
| Anonymization is blocked for patients with clinical notes or clinical documents, and the request is registered as "retenção legal". | UI-ANON-03, UI-ANON-04, E2E-ANON-04 |
| Anonymization is blocked while future appointments or open charges exist. | UI-ANON-05, UI-ANON-06, E2E-ANON-05 |
| Anonymization is not executed when the typed name does not match. | UI-ANON-02, E2E-ANON-05 |
| LGPD requests pending for more than 15 days are highlighted. | UI-REQUESTS-02 |

## UI

**Verification mode:** Render the surface, drive it with user-like inputs (clicks, typing, scrolling, keyboard); assert observable surface state (DOM, accessibility tree, visible text, navigation).

### Timeline

**Common given:** `timeline-admin` is signed in, the page of `patient-rich` is open, and the "Linha do tempo" tab is selected.

#### `UI-TIMELINE-01` — every event type is listed
- given: (default)
- when: scroll the timeline until "Fim da linha do tempo." is shown
- then:
  - events titled "Paciente cadastrado" and "Consentimento registrado" are listed
  - events titled "Agendamento" are listed
  - events titled "Registro clínico finalizado" and "Adendo adicionado" are listed
  - events titled "Documento enviado" and "Documento emitido" are listed
  - events titled "Cobrança {número} criada", "Pagamento recebido" and "Estorno registrado" are listed

#### `UI-TIMELINE-02` — newest first
- given: (default)
- when: read the date and time of every event loaded on the first two pages
- then:
  - each event's date and time is equal to or earlier than the one above it
  - `appt-future` is listed above `appt-history`
  - "Paciente cadastrado" is listed below every other event of the patient

#### `UI-TIMELINE-03` — 50 events on the first page
- given: (default)
- when: open the "Linha do tempo" tab
- then:
  - exactly 50 events are listed
  - a "Carregar mais eventos" button is shown below the list

#### `UI-TIMELINE-04` — the next page continues the list
- given: (default), with the first 50 events listed
- when: scroll to the end of the list
- then:
  - up to 50 more events are appended below the first 50
  - no event appears twice in the list
  - a live region announces how many events are loaded
- notes: activating "Carregar mais eventos" with the keyboard must produce the same result

#### `UI-TIMELINE-05` — end of the timeline
- given: (default)
- when: keep loading pages until no page is left
- then:
  - the text "Fim da linha do tempo." is shown below the last event
  - the "Carregar mais eventos" button is no longer shown

#### `UI-TIMELINE-06` — appointment status history
- given: (default)
- when: activate "Ver histórico" on the event of `appt-history`
- then:
  - the event shows the stamp "CONCLUÍDO"
  - a table lists the statuses Agendado, Confirmado, Chegou, Em atendimento and Concluído
  - each status line shows the date and time and the user who made the change

#### `UI-TIMELINE-07` — collapsed clinical items show no clinical text
- given: (default)
- when: read the collapsed event of `note-paula`
- then:
  - the event shows "Dra. Paula" and "Consulta"
  - the text "Paciente relata melhora da dor lombar." is not shown
  - a "Ver registro" control is shown with `aria-expanded="false"`

### Role filtering

#### `UI-VISIBILITY-01` — Front Desk sees no clinical event
- given: `timeline-desk` is signed in, the page of `patient-rich` is open, and the "Linha do tempo" tab is selected
- when: scroll the timeline until "Fim da linha do tempo." is shown
- then:
  - no event titled "Registro clínico finalizado" or "Adendo adicionado" is listed
  - no event of the document "Exame de sangue" is listed
  - the events of "RG digitalizado" and "Atestado" are listed
  - the charge, "Pagamento recebido" and "Estorno registrado" events are listed
  - the event type filter offers no "Registros clínicos" option

#### `UI-VISIBILITY-02` — Professionals see no financial event
- given: `timeline-pro` is signed in, the page of `patient-rich` is open, and the "Linha do tempo" tab is selected
- when: scroll the timeline until "Fim da linha do tempo." is shown
- then:
  - no charge, "Pagamento recebido" or "Estorno registrado" event is listed
  - the event type filter offers no "Financeiro" option
  - the events of `note-paula` and of its addendum are listed
  - the "Consentimento registrado" event and the event of `appt-history` are listed

#### `UI-VISIBILITY-03` — Professionals see their own appointments and the notes of others
- given: `timeline-pro` is signed in, the page of `patient-rich` is open, and the "Linha do tempo" tab is selected
- when: scroll the timeline until "Fim da linha do tempo." is shown
- then:
  - no appointment event of `appt-helena` is listed
  - the event of `note-helena` is listed with "Dra. Helena"

#### `UI-VISIBILITY-04` — an unlinked Manager sees financial but no clinical events
- given: `timeline-manager` is signed in, the page of `patient-rich` is open, and the "Linha do tempo" tab is selected
- when: scroll the timeline until "Fim da linha do tempo." is shown
- then:
  - the charge, "Pagamento recebido" and "Estorno registrado" events are listed
  - no event titled "Registro clínico finalizado" or "Adendo adicionado" is listed
  - no event of the document "Exame de sangue" is listed

### Clinical note expansion

**Common given:** `timeline-pro` is signed in, the page of `patient-rich` is open, and the "Linha do tempo" tab is selected.

#### `UI-NOTE-01` — expanding shows the full note
- given: (default)
- when: activate "Ver registro" on the event of `note-paula`
- then:
  - the text "Paciente relata melhora da dor lombar." is shown inside the event
  - the addendum "Retorno em 30 dias." is shown under a line "Adendo de Dra. Paula em" followed by its date and time
  - the control reads "Ocultar registro" with `aria-expanded="true"`

#### `UI-NOTE-02` — collapsing hides the note
- given: (default), with the note of `note-paula` expanded
- when: activate "Ocultar registro"
- then:
  - the text "Paciente relata melhora da dor lombar." is no longer shown
  - the control reads "Ver registro" with `aria-expanded="false"`

### Filters

**Common given:** `timeline-admin` is signed in, the page of `patient-rich` is open, and the "Linha do tempo" tab is selected.

#### `UI-FILTER-01` — filter by event type
- given: (default)
- when: in the group "Filtros da linha do tempo", leave only "Documentos" checked
- then:
  - only events titled "Documento enviado" or "Documento emitido" are listed
  - the events of "Exame de sangue", "RG digitalizado" and "Atestado" are listed

#### `UI-FILTER-02` — filter by period
- given: (default)
- when: fill "De" and "Até" with the local date of `appt-history`
- then:
  - every listed event has that date
  - the event of `appt-history` is listed
  - the event of `appt-future` is not listed

#### `UI-FILTER-03` — a period ending before it starts
- given: (default)
- when: fill "De" with 10/03/2026 and "Até" with 01/03/2026
- then:
  - the message "A data final deve ser igual ou posterior à data inicial." is shown under "Até"
  - the events listed before the change stay listed

#### `UI-FILTER-04` — a period without events
- given: (default)
- when: fill "De" with 01/01/2020 and "Até" with 31/01/2020
- then:
  - the text "Nenhum evento para os filtros selecionados." is shown
  - no event is listed

### Request register

**Common given:** `timeline-admin` is signed in and "LGPD > Solicitações" is open.

#### `UI-REQUESTS-01` — record a request
- given: (default)
- when: activate "Nova solicitação"; choose patient "Lia Fernandes", type "Acesso", requester "Paciente", and description "Paciente pediu cópia dos dados por e-mail."; activate "Registrar solicitação"
- then:
  - the side panel closes and the toast "Solicitação registrada." is shown
  - a new row lists today's date, "Lia Fernandes", "Acesso", "Paciente" and the stamp "PENDENTE"
  - the "Concluída em" cell of that row shows "—"

#### `UI-REQUESTS-02` — requests pending for more than 15 days are highlighted
- given: (default), with the status filter on "Abertas"
- when: read the rows of `request-overdue`, `request-day15` and `request-closed-old` (the last one with the status filter on "Todas")
- then:
  - the row of `request-overdue` carries the stamp "Pendente há 16 dias"
  - the row of `request-day15` carries no "Pendente há" stamp
  - the row of `request-closed-old` carries no "Pendente há" stamp
  - the row of `request-overdue` is listed above the row of `request-day15`

#### `UI-REQUESTS-03` — a description that is too short
- given: (default), with the "Nova solicitação" panel open
- when: fill the description with "Cópia" and activate "Registrar solicitação"
- then:
  - the message "Descreva a solicitação com pelo menos 10 caracteres." is shown under the description
  - the panel stays open and no new row is listed

#### `UI-REQUESTS-04` — only Administrators reach the register
- given: `timeline-manager` is signed in
- when: navigate to `/lgpd/requests`
- then:
  - the forbidden page is shown
  - the sidebar shows no "LGPD" group

#### `UI-REQUESTS-05` — complete a correction request
- given: (default)
- when: open `request-correction`; activate "Concluir solicitação"; fill the resolution "Telefone corrigido no cadastro."; confirm
- then:
  - the request shows the stamp "CONCLUÍDA"
  - "Concluída em" shows today's date
  - the resolution text is shown on the request

### Data export

**Common given:** `timeline-admin` is signed in.

#### `UI-EXPORT-01` — generate and offer the export
- given: (default), with `request-export` open
- when: activate "Gerar exportação" and wait for the generation to finish
- then:
  - while generating, the status line reads "Gerando exportação…" in a live region
  - when ready, the request shows the stamp "CONCLUÍDA"
  - a "Baixar exportação" button is shown
  - the text "Disponível até {data}" shows the date 7 days after the generation

#### `UI-EXPORT-02` — a failed generation
- given: (default), with `request-export-broken` open
- when: activate "Gerar exportação" and wait for the generation to end
- then:
  - the request shows the stamp "FALHA NA GERAÇÃO"
  - a "Tentar novamente" button is shown
  - no "Baixar exportação" button is shown

#### `UI-EXPORT-03` — an export past 7 days is not offered
- given: (default), with `request-export-expired` open
- when: read the export block of `export-expired`
- then:
  - the text "Exportação expirada em {data}" shows the end of its availability
  - no "Baixar exportação" button is offered for `export-expired`
  - a "Gerar novamente" button is shown

### Anonymization

**Common given:** `timeline-admin` is signed in.

#### `UI-ANON-01` — two confirmations, then anonymized
- given: (default), with `request-anon-ok` open
- when: activate "Anonimizar paciente"; continue past the warning; type "Rafael Mendes Costa"; activate "Anonimizar definitivamente"
- then:
  - the first step shows the irreversibility warning before any name field
  - the toast "Paciente anonimizado." is shown
  - the request shows the stamp "CONCLUÍDA"
  - the patient page of `patient-anon-ok` is titled "Paciente anonimizado #" followed by six characters, with the stamp "ANONIMIZADO"

#### `UI-ANON-02` — a name that does not match
- given: (default), with `request-anon-name` open
- when: activate "Anonimizar paciente"; continue past the warning; type "Helena Ramos"; activate "Anonimizar definitivamente"
- then:
  - the message "O nome digitado não confere." is shown under the name field
  - the request keeps the stamp "PENDENTE"
  - the patient page of `patient-anon-name` is still titled "Helena Duarte Ramos"

#### `UI-ANON-03` — clinical notes block and register legal retention
- given: (default), with `request-anon-clinical` open
- when: activate "Anonimizar paciente"
- then:
  - the message "Este paciente possui registros clínicos, que devem ser mantidos por no mínimo 20 anos (Lei 13.787/2018). A solicitação foi registrada e os dados não clínicos podem ser corrigidos, mas não anonimizados." is shown
  - no name field is offered
  - the request shows the stamp "SOLICITAÇÃO REGISTRADA — RETENÇÃO LEGAL"

#### `UI-ANON-04` — a clinical document alone also blocks
- given: (default), with `request-anon-clinicaldoc` open
- when: activate "Anonimizar paciente"
- then:
  - the legal retention message of PRD F14 is shown
  - no name field is offered
  - the request shows the stamp "SOLICITAÇÃO REGISTRADA — RETENÇÃO LEGAL"

#### `UI-ANON-05` — future appointments block
- given: (default), with `request-anon-future` open
- when: activate "Anonimizar paciente"
- then:
  - the message "Cancele os agendamentos futuros e regularize as cobranças em aberto antes de anonimizar." is shown
  - no name field is offered
  - the request keeps the stamp "PENDENTE"

#### `UI-ANON-06` — open charges block
- given: (default), with `request-anon-open` open
- when: activate "Anonimizar paciente"
- then:
  - the message "Cancele os agendamentos futuros e regularize as cobranças em aberto antes de anonimizar." is shown
  - no name field is offered
  - the request keeps the stamp "PENDENTE"

## Worker

**Verification mode:** Enqueue or trigger the input; observe the side effect on the system (database rows, stored objects, audit events) after processing completes.

### Data export

#### `WRK-EXPORT-01` — the ZIP holds the JSON, the summary and every file
- given: `request-export` of `patient-export` has an export in status generating
- when: the export build job for that export completes
- then:
  - the export is ready, and a ZIP object exists in storage at its key
  - the ZIP holds `dados.json`, `resumo.pdf` and the 5 stored files of `patient-export` under `arquivos/`
  - `dados.json` holds the sections patient, consents, appointments, clinicalNotes, documents and charges, carrying the patient's CPF, both appointments, the note text, the documents and the payment
  - the export's end of availability is exactly 7 days after its ready time
  - the request is completed with a completion date

#### `WRK-EXPORT-02` — 500 files within 5 minutes
- given: `request-export-500` has an export in status generating
- when: the export build job for that export runs
- then:
  - the export is ready within 5 minutes of the job start
  - the ZIP holds 500 entries under `arquivos/`, plus `dados.json` and `resumo.pdf`

#### `WRK-EXPORT-03` — a failure leaves no partial file
- given: `request-export-broken` has an export in status generating
- when: the export build job for that export runs
- then:
  - the export is failed with an error code and has no object key
  - no object exists in storage under the `privacy` prefix for that export
  - the request is in status Falha na geração

#### `WRK-EXPORT-04` — files are removed after 7 days
- given: `export-expired` and `export-fresh` exist with their files in storage
- when: the export cleanup job runs
- then:
  - the file of `export-expired` no longer exists in storage
  - `export-expired` is expired with an expiry timestamp
  - `export-fresh` is still ready, and its file still exists

#### `WRK-EXPORT-05` — the generation is audited
- given: `request-export` has an export in status generating
- when: the export build job for that export completes
- then:
  - an `audit_event` row with action `EXPORT` and the request's id records the generation, with the patient id and the file count in its metadata
  - an `audit_event` row with action `EXPORT` records the earlier request, with the requester kind and the reason "Paciente pediu cópia dos dados em 14/10." in its metadata

## E2E

**Verification mode:** Run the full system (application, worker, database, storage and browser); drive it the way a real user would; assert cross-stack behavior, including the responses the browser receives, the files it downloads, and the rows and objects written.

### Timeline

#### `E2E-TIMELINE-01` — loading within 2 seconds at p95
- given: `patient-heavy` exists; `timeline-admin`, `timeline-desk` and `timeline-pro` can each sign in
- when: for each of the three users, open the "Linha do tempo" tab of `patient-heavy` 20 times and load the next page each time
- then:
  - the 95th percentile of the time from opening the tab to the first 50 events being rendered is at most 2,000 ms for each user
  - the 95th percentile of the time from requesting the next page to its events being rendered is at most 2,000 ms for each user
  - every first page holds exactly 50 events
- notes: timings are taken in the browser from the user action to the rendered list; the first run of each user is a warm-up and is not counted

### Role filtering

#### `E2E-VISIBILITY-01` — no clinical data reaches a Front Desk browser
- given: `timeline-desk` is signed in on the page of `patient-rich`
- when: open the "Linha do tempo" tab and load every page with the event type filter set to each available option in turn
- then:
  - no timeline response received by the browser contains the id of `note-paula` or of its addendum
  - no timeline response received by the browser contains the title "Exame de sangue"
  - no timeline response received by the browser contains the text "Paciente relata melhora da dor lombar."

#### `E2E-VISIBILITY-02` — no financial data reaches a Professional browser
- given: `timeline-pro` is signed in on the page of `patient-rich`
- when: open the "Linha do tempo" tab and load every page with the event type filter set to each available option in turn
- then:
  - no timeline response received by the browser contains an event of a charge, payment or refund
  - no timeline response received by the browser contains the charge number of the `appt-history` charge

### Clinical note expansion

**Common given:** `timeline-pro` is signed in on the page of `patient-rich`, with the "Linha do tempo" tab selected.

#### `E2E-NOTE-READ-01` — an expansion writes an audit read event
- given: (default)
- when: activate "Ver registro" on the event of `note-paula`
- then:
  - one new `audit_event` row exists with action `READ_SENSITIVE`, entity type `clinical_note` and the id of `note-paula`
  - that row's actor is the user `timeline-pro`
  - that row carries a timestamp and an IP address
  - the note text is shown on the page

#### `E2E-NOTE-READ-02` — each expansion is audited
- given: (default)
- when: expand the event of `note-paula`, collapse it, and expand it again
- then:
  - two new `audit_event` rows exist with action `READ_SENSITIVE`, entity type `clinical_note` and the id of `note-paula`

#### `E2E-NOTE-READ-03` — listing without expanding does not read the note
- given: (default), before the tab is opened
- when: open the "Linha do tempo" tab without expanding any event
- then:
  - no new `audit_event` row exists with entity type `clinical_note` and the id of `note-paula`
  - one new `audit_event` row exists with action `READ_SENSITIVE`, entity type `patient` and the id of `patient-rich`, whose metadata lists the id of `note-paula`

### Data export

#### `E2E-EXPORT-01` — request, generate and download an export
- given: `timeline-admin` is signed in; `patient-export` exists
- when: record an access request for "Bruna Teixeira" with the description "Pedido de acesso aos dados feito no balcão."; open it; activate "Gerar exportação"; when it is ready, activate "Baixar exportação"
- then:
  - the browser downloads a file named `dados-paciente-` followed by a short id and `.zip`, whose name holds no part of the patient's name
  - the downloaded ZIP holds `dados.json`, `resumo.pdf` and the 5 stored files of `patient-export`
  - `audit_event` rows with action `EXPORT` for that request exist for the request, the generation and the download
  - the download's audit row carries the actor `timeline-admin`, the requester kind and the reason "Pedido de acesso aos dados feito no balcão."

### Anonymization

#### `E2E-ANON-01` — every personal identifier is replaced
- given: `timeline-admin` is signed in with `request-anon-ok` open
- when: complete the anonymization of `patient-anon-ok` by typing "Rafael Mendes Costa"
- then:
  - the patient row's full name is "Paciente anonimizado #" followed by a six-character code, and its social name is empty
  - the patient row's document, RG, email, address, secondary phone, guardian and observations are empty, and its mobile phone holds no digits
  - no new `audit_event` row written by the anonymization contains "Rafael", the CPF or the email of `patient-anon-ok`
  - the patient row carries an anonymization timestamp and is inactive

#### `E2E-ANON-02` — records are kept under the anonymized identity
- given: the anonymization of `patient-anon-ok` has completed (as in `E2E-ANON-01`)
- when: read the records of `patient-anon-ok`
- then:
  - its appointment, charge and payment rows still exist and still reference the same patient id
  - the document "RG digitalizado" still has a row, marked erased, and its stored file no longer exists in storage
  - its generated document and its consent still exist
  - the timeline of the patient still lists its appointment, charge and payment events

#### `E2E-ANON-03` — anonymization cannot be undone
- given: the anonymization of `patient-anon-ok` has completed (as in `E2E-ANON-01`)
- when: try to set the full name back to "Rafael Mendes Costa" with an UPDATE issued through the application's database role
- then:
  - the database refuses the change
  - the patient row still holds the placeholder name
  - the patient form for this patient is read-only on the patient page

#### `E2E-ANON-04` — legal retention is registered and nothing changes
- given: `timeline-admin` is signed in with `request-anon-clinical` open
- when: activate "Anonimizar paciente"
- then:
  - `request-anon-clinical` is stored with the status legal retention and a completion date
  - the patient row of `patient-anon-clinical` is unchanged
  - an `audit_event` row records the request's change to legal retention

#### `E2E-ANON-05` — blocked or mismatched attempts change nothing
- given: `timeline-admin` is signed in
- when: attempt the anonymization of `request-anon-future` and of `request-anon-open`, and of `request-anon-name` typing "Helena Ramos"
- then:
  - the patient rows of `patient-anon-future`, `patient-anon-open` and `patient-anon-name` are unchanged
  - the three requests are still in status Pendente
  - no `audit_event` row with action `UPDATE` on any of these three patients was written
